# namespace_bazel_cache (Ephemeral Resource)

Ensures Bazel remote cache infrastructure and obtains short-lived mTLS credentials and endpoints. Warning: Opening this ephemeral resource invokes an Ensure RPC that may create or reuse durable server-side cache infrastructure. Terraform does not manage the lifecycle of the underlying cache and will not delete it when destroyed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

ephemeral "namespace_bazel_cache" "ci_cache" {
  key  = "ci"
  site = "eu"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Cache access scope key: 'ci' or 'workstation'.

### Optional

- `enable_remote_asset_api` (Boolean) Enable remote asset API support on the cache endpoint.
- `experimental_cache_name` (String) Explicit cache namespace identifier.
- `experimental_direct_mtls` (Boolean) Enable direct mTLS connection mode.
- `site` (String) Optional site/region hint for cache placement.
- `version` (Number) Optional cache protocol version.

### Read-Only

- `build_event_endpoint` (String) Build Event Protocol (BES) streaming endpoint.
- `cache_endpoint` (String) Primary Bazel remote cache endpoint (gRPC/mTLS).
- `client_cert_pem` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded client certificate for mTLS authentication.
- `client_key_pem` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded private key for mTLS authentication.
- `credential_helper_domains` (List of String) Domains supported by the credential helper.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the issued mTLS credentials expire.
- `https_cache_endpoint` (String) HTTPS cache endpoint.
- `https_mtls_cache_endpoint` (String) HTTPS mTLS cache endpoint.
- `remote_asset_endpoint` (String) Remote Asset API endpoint.
- `server_ca_pem` (String) PEM-encoded server CA certificate.
- `use_workload_mtls` (Boolean) Whether workload identity mTLS is used.
